changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6e item 7b: DispatcherService's ~15 Team/Channel per-verb pass-through methods (createTeam, submitToTeamLeader, interruptTeamLeader, listTeams, getTeamStatus, getTeamHistory, dissolveTeam, dissolveTeamForLeader, team(), teamScheduler(), runForTeamLeader, prepareChannels(), startInputSources(), listChannels()) are deleted; DispatcherService now exposes readonly teams (TeamsPort), teammates (TeammateOps), channels (ChannelService), and scheduler (SchedulerCommands) directly, and every caller (team/commands.ts, team/mcp.ts, channel-service/commands.ts, dispatcher-service/mcp-delegates.ts, scheduler/commands.ts, server/command-catalog.ts) reaches the owning port itself. Pure internal restructuring: same Commands, same MCP tool names, same external behavior. workspace() is the one surviving pass-through, still needed by the TeamMate Command/MCP surface.
